title: The supply line is part of the war.
body: Civilian freight is getting regular routes and demand-driven fleet growth. Merchants carry reserved cargo between real suppliers and customers; new hulls need paid yard work. The latest pass is built and awaiting normal campaign testing.

title: The experience is aboard the ship.
body: Crew work now connects more experience to command review and working roles. Pilot callsigns and experience already travel with their people through rescue and transfer. The latest crew and succession changes still need playtesting.
link: Meet the people behind the machinery

title: Winning leaves people to bring home.
body: Rescue work now brings group orders, received distress signals and physical capsule recovery into the same operation. The current pass focuses on approach, collar traffic and getting the rescue formation out.

title: Getting aboard is only half the problem.
body: Boarding craft and a dedicated ram-and-board hull are in development. The approach, the marines and getting them home all belong to the same fight. This pass is built and awaiting playtesting.
link: Discuss the weapons they have to get past

title: Somebody has to pick up the pieces.
body: Repair work is expanding around finite supplies, replacement parts and a large support tender with service drones. Keeping a damaged ship alive and rebuilding what is missing are different jobs. The new pass still needs playtesting.
link: Explore damage and suggest what comes next

title: The fleet has a suggestion box.
body: Ideas, votes and replies are open without an account. Optional passkey identities keep a callsign and service record. Fleet Command responses stay attached to the original discussion.
